title: Read of a mutable field inside a try is done after a later call that raises
summary: Inside a `try`, `r := q.m` followed by a call that changes `q.m` and raises leaves the new value of `q.m` in `r`: the read is moved after the call. The same happens with a reference or an array element in place of the field, and with a `let mutable` variable in place of the reference.
cause: `middle_end/flambda2/to_cmm/to_cmm_expr.ml`, `translate_apply`: the extra arguments of the exception continuation are translated after the call is built and before it is in the environment, so a load used once is substituted into the handler, after the call.

fix.text: Binds the extra arguments of the exception continuation before the call. Builds; `test.ml` then prints the expected result; testsuite unchanged.
